# Bartolomé de las Casas

*1484 – 1566 · Spanish*

Spanish Dominican, a former colonist turned defender of the Indigenous peoples of the Americas, who denounced the violence of the conquest and argued at Valladolid that these peoples have the same natural rights as Europeans.
